title: Where is my child call script
description: A script for the staff taking calls from parents who ask where their child is: what to say, what never to say, what to ask and how to escalate. It does not confirm a student's whereabouts to a caller who cannot be verified and gives a fictional exercise number. Everything is fictional and marked as an exercise product; a real helpline number never appears without the EXERCISE marking, and no real person or address is used.

subtitle.description: Line under the organization: unit, site, period

examples: This is the Millbrook district family line. This is an exercise.
Thank you for calling. I will help you find where to go.
Is your child on the bus 14 roster, and what is the child's grade?
Are you on the release card for this student?

say.description: What to say about where to go
examples: Students are safe and being reunified at the church hall entrance on Elm Street.
Do not go to the crash site.
Never name a student's condition or say who is hurt.
Never confirm a student's location to an unverified caller.
Pass to the supervisor any caller who says they cannot reach the site, who is in distress or who names a custody dispute.
